purpose: Teach: 予見/告訴/蒸留/沈没/演算/概略/諜報/内政

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察、事件を予見されてましたか、というご質問ですね
lines.en: So you're saying the police had foreseen this case and the incident?
lines.style: Careful, methodical phrasing with slight upward lilt at the end. Genuinely seeking clarification, not challenging. Measured pace, the way someone talks when they're thinking aloud with an official.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者からの告訴を受理しました
lines.en: The police have accepted a complaint from the victim.
lines.style: Level, official tone. Crisp delivery without coldness. Each phrase placed deliberately, like stating facts into a record. Professional but not distant.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、不法蒸留所の摘発を警察、進められてますね
lines.en: So the police are moving forward with the investigation into the illegal distillery operation.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost thinking aloud. Testing the information, not doubting it. Slight pause before 'into' — making sure he has the thread right.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、漁船沈没事故の調査を継続しております
lines.en: The police are continuing our investigation into the fishing vessel sinking.
lines.style: Steady, no-nonsense. 'Continuing' carries the weight — this is ongoing, not settled. Eyes level. Calm authority without any need to perform it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、データの演算ミスを警察、確認されたんですね
lines.en: And the police have confirmed the computational error in the data, then.
lines.style: Slightly surprised undertone, but contained. Checking his own understanding. Voice quieter on 'confirmed' — acknowledging the significance of that confirmation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、事件の概略を記者会見で発表します
lines.en: The police will announce an outline of the case at a press conference.
lines.style: Formal, announced clearly. 'Will announce' lands with decision. No hesitation. The tone of someone moving to the next procedural step with full awareness of its weight.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、外国諜報活動を警察、警戒されてますね
lines.en: So the police are watching for foreign intelligence activity in this matter.
lines.style: Lowered voice, more serious. Less curiosity, more concern. Acknowledging the gravity of what he's learned. Steady eye contact level.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、内政干渉の事案にも対応します
lines.en: The police will also respond to cases involving foreign interference in domestic affairs.
lines.style: Firm, authoritative. Slight emphasis on 'also' — broadening the scope. No room for misunderstanding. Professional, clear-eyed delivery of scope and commitment.
